title: Center-Out Reveal
description: Các ký tự hiện ra từ giữa lan đều sang hai bên, mỗi ký tự phóng nhẹ từ 0.86 lần.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-center-out-reveal, written here): Split chars; delay = |i − centre| × 30 ms (demo up to 120 ms, capped so the outermost starts by 0.8 s), from 0.3 s. Each char opacity 0 → 1 and scale 0.86 → 1 over 0.45 s easeOutCubic (cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)); a symmetric build outward from the middle. Loop exit: fade 2.65–2.95 s inCubic; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.45 s) · stagger: từ giữa ra (0.03 s) · scale đầu (0.86) · ease (easeOutCubic).
